description: After the agent claims and acknowledges a mention, the human who mentioned it sees no change: the chip and comment look the same, and nothing says 'Setup agent picked this up' or 'acknowledged'. The reply comment is the only evidence.
expected: The mention chip or comment footer reflects delivery state (pending, claimed, acknowledged).
actual: No delivery state anywhere in the browser.
suggested_fix: Show per-mention state from model.mentions next to the comment (e.g. 'Setup agent · acknowledged 11:45').

description: `mentions pending` and `claim-next` return IDs and a digest but no comment text or task title, so the agent must `show` each task to triage. claim-next is strictly FIFO and claimed an older, unrelated mention first, which needed an extra ack and claim.
expected: Pending items include the comment excerpt and task title; claim-next can optionally take a mention ID.
suggested_fix: Include taskTitle and comment text in pending/claim output; add `mentions claim <id>`.
